## Activity

During February 2024, Central Eye Clinic recorded 173 captures. This provides the activity total for the reporting period and reflects the imaging work completed at the site. The capture count is reported alongside the image-quality and grading results to provide a concise view of site operations.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 2 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.2 per cent. These figures identify the number of captures that could not be used for grading and the corresponding proportion of activity during February 2024.

## Grading

Grading identified 50 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 2 days. Taken together, the grading figures record both the number of referable results and the time taken for results to progress through grading. The activity, image-quality and grading measures provide the operational summary for Central Eye Clinic for February 2024.
